from pynetdicom import AE, evt, build_context, build_role
from pynetdicom import sop_class as SC

def link(uids, handlers=(), scp=None, scu=None, ext_neg=None, scu_handlers=None, **scp_kwargs):
    scp = scp or AE(ae_title="SCP")
    for uid in uids:
        scp.add_supported_context(uid)

    scu = scu or AE(ae_title="SCU")
    for uid in uids:
        scu.add_requested_context(uid)
    return connect(scu, port, ext_neg=ext_neg or [], evt_handlers=scu_handlers or [])

def roles(scu_role, scp_role, acc_scu, acc_scp):
    seen = {}
    def on_accept(event):
        cxs = event.assoc.accepted_contexts
        seen["acceptor"] = sorted([cx.abstract_syntax == SC.CTImageStorage, cx.as_scu, cx.as_scp] for cx in cxs)
    scp = AE(ae_title="SCP")
    scp.add_supported_context(SC.CTImageStorage, scu_role=acc_scu, scp_role=acc_scp)
    scp.add_supported_context(SC.Verification)
    port = serve(scp, [(evt.EVT_ACCEPTED, on_accept)])
    scu = AE(ae_title="SCU")
    scu.add_requested_context(SC.CTImageStorage)
    scu.add_requested_context(SC.Verification)
    assoc = connect(scu, port, ext_neg=[build_role(SC.CTImageStorage, scu_role=scu_role, scp_role=scp_role)])
    mine = sorted([cx.abstract_syntax == SC.CTImageStorage, cx.as_scu, cx.as_scp] for cx in assoc.accepted_contexts)
    rejected = [str(cx.abstract_syntax) for cx in assoc.rejected_contexts]
    assoc.release()
    time.sleep(0.05)
    return [assoc.is_established, mine, rejected, seen.get("acceptor")]

from pynetdicom.sop_class import PatientRootQueryRetrieveInformationModelGet as GETM
def c_get(sub_statuses, nr=None, handler=None, final=None):
    def handle_get(event):
        yield len(sub_statuses) if nr is None else nr
        for index in range(len(sub_statuses)):
            yield (0xFF00, image(instance=f"1.2.3.{index + 1}"))
        if final is not None:
            yield final
    replies = list(sub_statuses)
    def handle_store(event):
        return replies.pop(0)
    scp = AE(ae_title="SCP")
    scp.add_supported_context(GETM)
    scp.add_supported_context(SC.CTImageStorage, scu_role=False, scp_role=True)
    port = serve(scp, [(evt.EVT_C_GET, handler or handle_get)])
    scu = AE(ae_title="SCU")
    scu.add_requested_context(GETM)
    scu.add_requested_context(SC.CTImageStorage)
    assoc = connect(scu, port, ext_neg=[build_role(SC.CTImageStorage, scp_role=True)],
                    evt_handlers=[(evt.EVT_C_STORE, handle_store)])
    out = []
    for status, identifier in assoc.send_c_get(ds(QueryRetrieveLevel="PATIENT", PatientID="1234"), GETM):
        row = [status_of(status)]
        for key in ("NumberOfRemainingSuboperations", "NumberOfCompletedSuboperations",
                    "NumberOfFailedSuboperations", "NumberOfWarningSuboperations"):
            row.append(status.get(key, None) if status is not None else None)
        failed = None
        if identifier is not None and "FailedSOPInstanceUIDList" in identifier:
            value = identifier.FailedSOPInstanceUIDList
            failed = [str(v) for v in value] if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)) or type(value).__name__ == "MultiValue" else ([str(value)] if value else [])
        row.append(failed)
        out.append(row)
    assoc.release()
    return out

    port = serve(scp, [(evt.EVT_C_MOVE, handle_move)])
    scu = AE(ae_title="SCU")
    scu.add_requested_context(MOVEM)
    assoc = connect(scu, port)
    out = []
    for status, identifier in assoc.send_c_move(ds(QueryRetrieveLevel="PATIENT", PatientID="1234"), "STORE", MOVEM):
        row = [status_of(status)]
        for key in ("NumberOfRemainingSuboperations", "NumberOfCompletedSuboperations",
                    "NumberOfFailedSuboperations", "NumberOfWarningSuboperations"):

from pynetdicom.pdu_primitives import UserIdentityNegotiation
def identify(id_type, handler=None, positive=False):
    item = UserIdentityNegotiation()
    item.user_identity_type = id_type
    item.primary_field = b"user"
    if id_type == 2:
        item.secondary_field = b"pass"
    item.positive_response_requested = positive
    handlers = [] if handler is None else [(evt.EVT_USER_ID, handler)]
    assoc = link([SC.Verification], handlers, ext_neg=[item])
    established, rejected = assoc.is_established, assoc.is_rejected
    response = None
    if established and assoc.acceptor.user_identity is not None:
        response = assoc.acceptor.user_identity.server_response
    if established:
        assoc.release()
    return [established, rejected, response]
result = identify(1)

def link(uids, handlers=(), scp=None, scu=None, ext_neg=None, scu_handlers=None, **scp_kwargs):
    scp = scp or AE(ae_title="SCP")
    for uid in uids:
        scp.add_supported_context(uid)
    port = serve(scp, handlers, **scp_kwargs)
    scu = scu or AE(ae_title="SCU")
    for uid in uids:
        scu.add_requested_context(uid)
    return connect(scu, port, ext_neg=ext_neg or [], evt_handlers=scu_handlers or [])

def nsvc(uid, event, handler, call):
    assoc = link([uid], [(event, handler)])
    try:
        return call(assoc)
    finally:
        assoc.release()
def pair_of(response):
    status, dataset = response
    return [status_of(status), None if dataset is None else sorted((str(e.keyword), str(e.value)) for e in dataset)]
